item.content:encoded:
I tried to find a happy medium between 'just loud enough to hear' and 'just soft enough to wonder if you're imagining it', but ultimately, I think it depends on your headphones.

I will say I think this is the big thing. The laptop speakers, even though they are "Bang & Olufsen" tuned, are still laptop speakers and I couldn't hear anything at first. I put on my headphones and suddenly could BARELY hear something even with the volume turned up high. When I turned on the noise cancellation though, WHAM the creep factor ratchets up to 11. Not only could I somewhat clearly hear the audio but, even though I still wasn't really able to discern the words, all of the sudden there was an incredible intimacy to the audio I wasn't able to feel before…

These videos are a masterclass in exploiting fears of the darkness and the unknown. *shudder*
